messages.author: f06db63329fab1f9
messages.subject: Re: Library e1071
parts:
It looks like the R package "class" is not on your classpath.

"class" is a transitive dependency of e1071, so if you are using Maven/Grail/Ivy, this should be automatically added to your classpath.

See the documentation on project setup here:
http://docs.renjin.org/en/latest/library/project-setup.html

Also make sure you are using the latest version of Renjin, as I recall that there was once an issue with packages with names like "class" that are reserved in the Java language.

Best,
Alex

messages.author: f06db63329fab1f9
messages.subject: Re: Library e1071
parts:
If you don't use a build tool, then you will need to download all of your dependencies and transitive dependencies manually. This is definitely NOT recommended as it is not unusual for R packages to have dozens of transitive dependencies, all of which you must locate and copy to your classpath.

Again, please review the documentation on setting up your Java project for help organizing your project:
http://docs.renjin.org/en/latest/library/project-setup.html

Hope this helps!

Alex
